Isaac " Bougie " Herzog ( Hebrew : יִצְחָק "בּוּזִ'י" הֶרְצוֹג , romanized : Yitskhak "Buzhi" Hertsog ; born 22 September 1960) is an Israeli politician who has been serving since 2021 as the president of Israel . He is the first president to have been born in Israel after its Declaration of Independence .
